newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Trizec, Hungary Polus set up real estate JV.
newsitem.headline: Trizec, Hungary Polus set up real estate JV.

text.p: Canada's Trizec Corporation Ltd and Hungary's Granit Polus Rt have set up a 50-50 joint venture (JV) to develop shopping centers, office projects and business parks in Central Europe, Trizec said.
"This is an important step in Trizec's global growth strategy," said Gregory C. Wilkins, President and CEO of Trizec in a statement on Friday.
"The combination of Trizec's extensive real estate expertise and Polus' experience in Central Europe puts us in a unique position to achieve growth."
Trizec, one of North America's largest real estate companies, belongs to the Horsham holding controlled by Peter Munk, a Hungarian-Canadian.
Polus is a Budapest-based development group, controlled by the local businessman Sandor Demjan.
The statement did not release financial data on the JV's share capital or planned investments.
However, Granit Polus earlier said the joint venture would like to manage projects worth some $3 billion.
The joint venture's managing director is Ferenc Bartha, former President of the National Bank of Hungary and the country's privatisation chief in 1994-1995.
